title: Nautilus Drops│鸚鵡螺掉落物
description: Nautilus will drop items when killed in any way.│鸚鵡螺無論以何種方式被擊殺都會掉落物品。
body:
# Function│功能
- Nautiluses and Zombie Nautiluses will drop loot regardless of how they are killed.│鸚鵡螺和殭屍鸚鵡螺無論以何種方式被殺死都會掉落戰利品。
- The drop rate of Nautilus Shells from Nautiluses is increased to 50%/60%/70%/80% (without looting/looting I/looting II/looting II).│鸚鵡螺掉落鸚鵡螺殼的概率提升至50%/60%/70%/80%（無掠奪/掠奪I/掠奪II/掠奪II）。
